title: Find companies to approach
summary: A list of companies that look like good customers, found by searching outside.
text: Find companies that match our ideal customer and the kind I describe here: [kind]. Give a short list, with why each one fits and where you found it. Aim for the number in [count] if I gave one. Do not contact anyone and do not send anything. Do not invent a company: list only what you actually found, and say so plainly if you found fewer.
